en.text: The Red Raincoat. Written by Kiran Kasturia, illustrated by Zainab Tambawalla.

visual.prompt: A cheerful 6-year-old boy with messy black hair excitedly holding up a shiny crimson red raincoat with yellow buttons in a cozy living room, smiling gentle mother in mint green batik blouse watching lovingly, soft watercolor picture book illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Pada hari Minggu, orang tua Manu membelikan sebuah jas hujan merah yang indah. Bolehkah aku memakainya sekarang, Bu? tanya Manu. Belum, sayang. Hujan belum turun, jawab Ibu.
audio.foleyCue: Raincoat fabric rustling, cheerful boy chuckle

en.text: On Sunday, Manu's parents got him a shiny red raincoat. Ma, may I wear it now? asked Manu. No, my dear, the rains are not here yet, said Ma.

visual.prompt: A 6-year-old boy in yellow striped shirt standing outdoors in a sunlit garden beside blooming yellow sunflowers, shielding eyes looking up at a dazzling bright golden sun in a clear sky, soft whimsical watercolor style --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Hari Senin sangat cerah. Apakah hari ini akan hujan, Bu? tanya Manu. Tidak Manu, matahari bersinar sangat terang, kata Ibu.
audio.foleyCue: Warm summer breeze, cheerful chirping sparrows

en.text: Monday was bright and sunny. Will it rain today, Ma? asked Manu. No Manu, not today, the sun is shining high, said Ma.

visual.prompt: A 6-year-old boy sitting on a rustic wooden garden bench holding a neatly folded red raincoat on his lap, looking up with a thoughtful hopeful expression at an expanse of cloudless blue sky, watercolor picture book illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Hari Selasa langit begitu biru. Bu, kapan keinginanku akan terwujud? tanya Manu. Belum hari ini, sayang, senyum Ibu.
audio.foleyCue: Gentle wind chime tinkling, cicadas humming softly

en.text: Tuesday had clear blue skies. Ma, when will my wish come true? asked Manu. Not today, my dear, smiled Ma.

visual.prompt: A 6-year-old boy sitting on a shaded veranda faning himself with a palm leaf fan on a hot afternoon, shiny red raincoat hanging on a coat rack behind him, caring mother handing him a cold glass of water, whimsical watercolor --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Hari Rabu terasa sangat panas. Kenapa tidak hujan juga, Bu? tanya Manu kehausan. Ibu rasa sebentar lagi hujan akan datang, kata Ibu.
audio.foleyCue: Ice cubes clinking in glass, paper fan whoosh

en.text: Wednesday was hot and humid. Why doesn't it rain, Ma? asked Manu. I think it will rain very soon, said Ma.

visual.prompt: A cheerful 6-year-old boy with red raincoat draped over his shoulder at a grassy park picnic, checking the sky beside a woven picnic basket under large shade trees, playful children book watercolor illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Hari Kamis, Manu pergi piknik ke taman. Bagaimana kalau turun hujan, Bu? Tidak, sayang. Hari ini tidak akan hujan, jawab Ibu.
audio.foleyCue: Footsteps on grass, picnic basket wicker creaking

en.text: On Thursday, Manu went on a picnic. What if it rains, Ma? No, my dear, it will not rain today, replied Ma.

visual.prompt: A 6-year-old boy on a house veranda pointing excitedly up at dark puffy charcoal rain clouds rolling over tropical green trees, wind blowing leaves, anticipatory dramatic watercolor illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Hari Jumat awan kelabu mulai berkumpul. Bu, apakah hari ini akan hujan? tanya Manu cemas. Mungkin saja, awan gelap mulai terlihat, kata Ibu.
audio.foleyCue: Gusting cool wind, distant low rumble of thunder

en.text: Friday was cloudy and dim. Ma, will it rain today? asked Manu eagerly. It might, there are dark clouds gathering, said Ma.

visual.prompt: Dramatic heavy tropical torrential downpour sweeping across a garden veranda, big splashes of water bouncing on pavement, flash of lightning illuminating stormy sky, whimsical dynamic watercolor painting --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Hari Sabtu dimulai dengan gemuruh petir! GLUDUK-GLUDUK! BRRRUM! Dan hujan lebat pun turun mencurah!
audio.foleyCue: Thunderclap, heavy torrential rain roaring on roof, splashing water

en.text: Saturday began with a giant bang! CRACK-BOOM! RUMBLE! And the rain poured down heavily!

visual.prompt: A joyful 6-year-old boy dancing and splashing in rain puddles with open arms getting completely drenched, while his shiny red raincoat is still hanging forgotten on a dry veranda chair behind him, mother laughing fondly at the doorway, whimsical children storybook watercolor --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Horeee, hujan turun! Manu berlari keluar menyambut hujan. Tapi Manu... kamu lupa memakai jas hujan merahmu!
audio.foleyCue: Water splash, joyful child laughter, mother laughing, slide whistle

en.text: Hooray, it's raining! Manu ran outside dancing in the rain. But Manu... you forgot to wear your red raincoat!
